# Giuseppe Di Guglielmo

Principal Engineer at Fermilab (Intelligent Microelectronics Systems Division)
and Adjunct Associate Professor in Electrical and Computer Engineering at
Northwestern University. Specializes in system-level design and hardware
acceleration for AI/ML, with over 15 years of experience in high-level
synthesis for ASIC and FPGA design. Works with scientists to build
intelligent detectors for harsh environments with ultra-low-latency
requirements, including radiation-resistant ML-enriched chips for the Large
Hadron Collider and ML algorithms for quantum readout and control running at
cryogenic temperatures.

Contact: gdg@fnal.gov
